items.question: What additional puraścaraṇa circumstance is introduced after the five-limbed rite?
premises: The verse adds an another-island circumstance.
It is introduced by ca yat.
items.inference: The rite includes a circumstance involving one who has gone to another island.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of yat is not fully recoverable from this fragment.
items.plain_english: And that which has gone to another island.
